headline.purpose: Compact section titles inside the operator console.

body.purpose: Dense table, inspector, and recovery copy.

numeric.purpose: Ports, addresses, timestamps, protocols, and comparable measurements.

shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Fatal state and selected work surface when separation is necessary.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Button, border, color, and shadow state changes.

motion.name: list-entry
motion.purpose: New event and task rows; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: activity-spin
motion.purpose: Explicit in-progress indicators; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Command
components.description: Direct operator command such as test, validate, switch, or retry.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; background: var(--orange, #d6522e); font: 700 13px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--orange-dark, #ae3d20); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(125,48,27,.22); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #1872a5) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Command
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9ca59d); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text, #202421); background: var(--surface, #f8faf7); font: 700 13px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #eef1ed); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #1872a5) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Regional Port Socket
components.description: Fixed SOCKS entry with state lamp and immutable port identity.
components.css: .ds-port { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9px 1fr; gap: 4px 8px; min-width: 96px; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; color: #202421; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d6522e; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(39,50,40,.12); } .ds-port i { align-self: center; grid-row: 1 / span 2; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #14786f; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-port strong { font: 700 14px/1.2 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-port small { color: #59635b; font: 11px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-port:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5ca3c9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mode Segmented Control
components.description: Three-way automatic, locked, and disabled operating mode selector.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 3px; background: #dce1dc; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px; color: #59635b; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 11px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-segmented button:hover { color: #202421; background: rgba(255,255,255,.52); } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: #202421; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(26,34,27,.12); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5ca3c9; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Detail Tabs
components.description: Candidate, job, and event navigation with integrated count readout.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; background: #dde2dc; border-bottom: 1px solid #9ca59d; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 13px; color: #59635b; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font: 700 12px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #202421; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color: #202421; background: #f8faf7; border-bottom-color: #d6522e; } .ds-tabs span { display: inline-block; min-width: 20px; padding: 2px 5px; background: #cbd2cb; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5ca3c9; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Password Field
components.description: Operator authentication field with explicit focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #202421; font: 700 12px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 46px; padding: 0 13px; color: #202421; background: #f8faf7; border: 1px solid #9ca59d; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1.2 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #1872a5; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(24,114,165,.16); }

components.name: Protocol Tag
components.description: Compact transport marker within dense candidate tables.
components.css: .ds-protocol { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 5px; color: #31594f; background: #dfeae5; border-radius: 3px; font: 700 10px/1 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview: Gate looks like a compact instrument used repeatedly by one operator, not a general-purpose analytics dashboard. A graphite command rail, numbered port sockets, hairline dividers, and an explicit route trace make the fixed-entry/dynamic-exit model visible before any action is taken. The interface is quiet, dense, and factual. Work surfaces are cool and nearly white; color is reserved for command intent and operational state.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational density with clear scan lines.
Fixed SOCKS ports presented as physical sockets on one rail.
Oxide orange for deliberate commands, teal for verified health, and red for exact failure.
Tabular numerals and monospace endpoints wherever values must be compared.
Flat work surfaces separated by borders, with elevation reserved for selection and overlays.

rules.name: Sparse Signal
rules.body: Saturated colors communicate command or state; they do not decorate empty space.

rules.name: Status Truth
rules.body: Green or teal appears only after end-to-end validation has succeeded.

rules.name: Instrument Readout
rules.body: Use mono only for values an operator compares or transcribes.

rules.name: Local Overflow
rules.body: A rail or data table may scroll horizontally; the page root may not.

rules.name: Flat Workbench
rules.body: Resting page sections use borders and tonal layering, not floating cards.

dos: Do keep fixed ports and dynamic exits visually distinct.
Do use tabular numeric treatment for ports, IP addresses, latency, and timestamps.
Do show loading, empty, disabled, failed, and reconnecting states in place.
Do keep actions reversible, named, and adjacent to the state they affect.
Do preserve keyboard focus, text labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace the workbench with detached metric cards or a marketing dashboard.
Don't use healthy teal for unverified VPN Gate metadata or an API-only score.
Don't hide failure reasons behind a generic offline label when exact evidence exists.
Don't expose desktop-only interactions or allow the document root to overflow on mobile.
Don't add gradients, decorative illustrations, oversized headings, or soft pill controls.
